Before using this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, to other products containing follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH), or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other complications. Be aware that this treatment may result in multiple births. Discontinue use of this medication if you become pregnant, as it must not be used during pregnancy. It is unknown whether this drug passes into breast milk. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. While using this medication, your doctor may order laboratory and/or medical tests, such as vaginal ultrasounds, hormone level assessments, or liver function tests, to monitor your progress and ensure safety. Attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. If you miss a dose, contact your doctor or pharmacist promptly to establish a new dosing schedule. To store this medication, keep it in the refrigerator or at room temperature, away from light. Do not freeze it.
